# Hotel Chinmaye Inn

> Premium hotel in Bhagalpur (the Silk City), Bihar, India — est. 2015 with 60 rooms & suites, the Kesaria rooftop restaurant and five banquet halls, about 3 km from Bhagalpur Junction railway station. Part of the Chinmaye Hotels family.

## Key facts
- Address: RBSR Path, Khanjarpur, Bhagalpur, Bihar 812001, India
- Coordinates: 25.2562906, 86.9955132
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 88772 22233 (24-hour reception)
- Email: info@chinmaye.in
- Instagram: @chinmayeinn
- Map: https://maps.app.goo.gl/Wm8hhCpK1s4CsVdu7

## Rooms
- Deluxe Suite — king bed, sitting lounge, bathtub; from ₹4,999/night (indicative)
- Executive Room — king bed, sitting corner, work desk; from ₹3,999/night (indicative)
- Business Class Room — double bed, work desk; from ₹2,999/night (indicative)
- All rooms air-conditioned; complimentary breakfast and Wi-Fi; station pickup & drop available

## Dining & events
- Kesaria: rooftop multi-cuisine restaurant (Indian, Oriental, Continental), top floor — signatures: Dhingri Dilkhush ₹389 (house secret recipe), Murgh Mussallam ₹899, Hyderabadi Biryani from ₹389, Litchi Mirchi Jhatka ₹199 (signature drink); candle-light dinners, Sunday outdoor breakfast
- Five banquet halls:
  - Maya — 300–350 guests, first floor, the city's first upscale hall
  - Manjusha — up to 500 guests, second floor, only indoor + outdoor hall, city view
  - Maithili — intimate multi-purpose hall (conferences, kitty parties, workshops)
  - Moonlight — open-air rooftop banquet, city & Ganga views, live counters
  - Mandala — details on request

## Booking
- Online: secure booking handoff on https://chinmaye.in/
- WhatsApp/Call: +91 88772 22233

## Family
- Part of Chinmaye Hotels: https://group.chinmaye.in/
- Sister properties: The Chinmaye Grand (Bhagalpur, opening soon) and Chinmaye Deoghar (opening 2027)
